diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Bloomberg reported that after months of deadlock in negotiations with the US, the Islamic Republic is considering Qatar's proposals regarding its nuclear activities; an action that could restart the stalled talks.

The Telegraph revealed in an exclusive report confidential documents showing that a secret committee in the parliament, before the war began, proposed strengthening military relations with Russia and China and developing air defense, missiles, and drones for the survival of the Islamic Republic. The newspaper disclosed that the Islamic Republic and Russia are negotiating an agreement to send advanced air defense systems to Tehran. The Telegraph wrote that Mojtaba Khamenei, leader of the Islamic Republic, sent Mohsen Rezaei to the Kremlin with a personal letter whose main request was the supply of the S-400 air defense system.

The defeat of the Republicans in the US midterm elections has increased discussions about the future of Pete Hegseth, the country's Secretary of Defense, and his responsibility in the war with the Islamic Republic. At the same time, a Republican member of Congress has called for Hegseth's impeachment.

Hassan Ameli, the Friday prayer leader of Ardabil, said on 15 Aban that the US election and Trump's humiliating defeat are part of God's revenge and the oppressed's revenge against the oppressor. He added that Trump is under severe criticism and reprimands and is dying every moment but cannot find death. Ameli attributed this situation to the blood of their martyred leader.

A group of Iranians on the route from Gothenburg to Frankfurt expressed support for Prince Reza Pahlavi, who is set to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation in Germany, and commemorated the martyrs of the national revolution.

In two work accidents at Rayan Polymer Pouya Company and a gypsum factory in Espiran, Tabriz, one worker died and two others were injured. Also, a well-digger worker in Mashhad was injured after falling into a well.

The Nobel Peace Center in Oslo was transformed into a realm of light on Thursday, 14 Aban, with light artworks by artists from across Europe. The fifth edition of the "Fjord Oslo" festival has illuminated buildings and public spaces in Norway's capital with large-scale light installations. This festival is part of the European cultural cooperation project "Imagining Peace," funded by the European Union.

In the past week, reports covered illegal hunting and wood smuggling in dozens of locations, sightings of cheetahs and leopards, air pollution especially in Khuzestan and Isfahan, leachate and sewage entering rivers, drought, and land subsidence. A total of 106 independent environmental news items were collected, including arrests, air quality records, wildlife observation and release, and other topics. This review is based on reports from various media and organizations.

Farhikhtegan reported with a video that Alireza Beiranvand is present at the national teams' camp. Mehdi Rajabzadeh, the coach of Fajr, said that whatever Beiranvand does is coordinated with the club and that he is currently injured and following up on his injury. Also, some Fajr Sepasi players reported Beiranvand's presence at the team hotel after the match with Persepolis.

BBC Verify, citing the British intelligence company Mayar, reported that satellite images show new excavation and construction at military bases in Garmdareh Karaj and Shahroud. The report mentions reconstruction at at least 12 other military sites, including missile and air bases damaged in US and Israeli attacks. Jim Lamson suggested the Shahroud excavations may be related to missile production, and a new entrance was identified in Karaj.

Published images show that a group of cinema actors, football figures, and sportspeople attended the memorial ceremony for the late Hamid Alidousti, former striker of Iran's national football team and Homa club, on Friday evening and expressed condolences to Taraneh Alidousti and her family. The wives of the late Nasser Hejazi and Ali Daei were also seen among the attendees. The ceremony was held at the Jame Mosque of Shahrak-e Gharb.

A motorcade carrying Lion and Sun flags traveled the streets of Frankfurt, Germany, on Friday, 15 Aban. The city is where Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation on behalf of the Iranian people.

Donald Trump said that if the Islamic Republic had not been prevented from acquiring nuclear weapons, Israel and the entire Middle East would not exist today. On Friday, 15 Aban, he wrote on Truth Social that no one wants to say this but everyone knows it is true.
A report states that Diar Abron, a citizen from Piranshahr, was detained by security forces on 11 Aban. There has been no information about the location of this citizen's detention so far.

Ebrahim Azizi, head of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, wrote on X that they will not allow Trump to escape the region without cost or compensation. He also said their response to any mistake will be a decisive strike to free the largest US military base, Israel, once and for all. These statements were published on Friday, 15 Aban.

After Persepolis's home defeat against Fajr Sepasi in the twelfth week of the Premier League, the team's fans chanted against Mehdi Tartaar, demanding his departure. This was Persepolis's second home defeat and third loss in the Premier League. Mehdi Tartaar's team, which was leading the league before this match, fell 3 points behind Sepahan and lost the title race to Moharram Navidkia's team.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, accepted responsibility after his team's defeat against Fajr Sepasi and said that the pressure from the stands caused the players' failure to score. He criticized the fans' behavior and called for cheering until the 90th minute. Tartaar also said they follow the club's decision regarding team fines and hopes conditions improve with better results.
It was reported in the audio version of Harfe Akhar with Pouria Zeraati that Trump's order to start the heaviest military operation in the last ten years was mentioned.

On Friday, 15 Aban, a number of citizens in Shahroud held a march and protest demanding the closure of the bauxite mine in the city. According to these citizens, the continuation of the mine's activities has seriously endangered the region's water resources and environment.
It was reported in the audio version 24 with Fardad Farahzad that there is a security threat against Prince Reza Pahlavi in Germany.

A U.S. military official told Iran International that the United States is concerned about the safety and security of the people of Iran and urges them to stay home and keep away from IRGC forces and centers if military tensions escalate.

Forough Kenani, a sociology researcher and women's rights activist, said that despite the announcement of security restrictions on the presence of Prince Reza Pahlavi and his wife at the Frankfurt event, no changes have been made to the gathering's program so far. She considered this decision a sign of Germany's weak political will in confronting threats from the Islamic Republic. Kenani added that limiting Reza Pahlavi's presence weakens the voice of Iranians who cannot freely protest inside the country.

Rouhollah Rahimpour said Qatar's new plan to reduce tensions between Tehran and Washington, despite considering some demands of both sides, still remains distant from the conditions of the Islamic Republic and the nuclear demands of the US. He added that the Islamic Republic, by continuing to review this proposal, tries to delay the outbreak of war to benefit from political pressures on Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu. Rahimpour assessed the chances of reaching an agreement as low and said diplomatic efforts have not yet reduced the risk of the war restarting.

Iran International's exclusive investigation shows that the Islamic Republic has created a network to expand media influence using shell companies and cash payments through its embassy in the UK. More than 41,000 pounds were paid through a company in London to Ahmad Kabalo, a former Press TV journalist and founder of media such as African Stream and Sovereign Media. At least five former Press TV colleagues also work in these media to publish narratives aligned with Tehran.

Shahad Alavi, a member of Iran International's editorial team, said that the trial of three defendants accused of spying for the Islamic Republic with the aim of harming two Iran International journalists has ended in a London court, and the jury has entered the deliberation phase. He does not find the defendants' lawyers' defenses convincing and predicted that the jury will find the defendants guilty of serious charges, but the final decision has not yet been announced.

Yasmin Pahlavi said Frankfurt police officially informed them that they are not allowed to attend or speak at the Saturday gathering and will prevent their presence. The police cited threats from the Islamic Republic to violence and the possibility of participants being targeted as reasons for this decision. Yasmin Pahlavi considered this decision influenced by political considerations.

Domestic media reported early Saturday about hearing explosions and aircraft movement in Qeshm Island and Bandar Khamir. IRNA news agency, quoting eyewitnesses, stated that two projectiles hit the Suza area on Qeshm Island, but provincial sources have not yet explained the nature and details. Fars news agency confirmed hearing the explosions in Qeshm and Bandar Khamir and suggested this event might be related to a warning shot fired towards the Strait of Hormuz.

Prince Reza Pahlavi's press office announced that he will participate in the Friedrich Naumann Freedom Award ceremony and is determined to attend the Iranian gathering in Frankfurt afterward. The office said the gathering will proceed as planned. Earlier, his wife stated that German police prevented his speech at the gathering due to potential threats from the Islamic Republic.

Persepolis football team lost 2-1 to Fajr Sepasi in the twelfth week of the Premier League at Ghal'eh Hasan Khan Stadium. Mehdi Tartaar, the coach of the Reds, complained about Persepolis fans' chants against the players after the match.

Mohammad Taghavi analyzed the Persepolis - Fajr Sepasi match on the Hattrick program and said Persepolis has scored only one goal in the last three games, indicating a weak attack line. He also said the defense line situation of Persepolis is worrying.
Tasnim News Agency reported that according to initial reports, two missiles hit Qeshm Island. This report was published after sounds of explosions were heard in Qeshm and Bandar Khamir.

The international media office of the Qatari government denied reports of a failure in negotiations for an agreement between the US and the Islamic Republic, stating that those benefiting from ongoing war and instability in the region have deliberately distorted the statements of the Qatari Prime Minister to undermine diplomatic efforts. The statement emphasized that the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister of Qatar announced that both sides are still striving to reach an agreement, and Qatari mediators remain in close coordination with the US and Iranian government to support ongoing negotiations.

Houshang Hassaniyari, a Middle East and military affairs expert, said that the arms cooperation between Russia and the Islamic Republic continues and its dimensions go beyond usual military deals. According to him, Moscow pursues long-term goals by delivering advanced equipment and expanding missile cooperation with Tehran, indirectly opposing the US. Hassaniyari added that Donald Trump's administration needs Russia to advance Ukraine peace talks and maintain a diplomatic channel with the Islamic Republic, while facing continued Russian military support for Tehran.

Sepahan football team fans set off fireworks during the match against Malavan at Naghsh-e Jahan Stadium in Isfahan on Friday, 15 Aban. They created an extraordinary atmosphere similar to scenes created by Borussia Dortmund fans at Signal Iduna Park stadium in Germany.

Donald Trump said in a speech at a NASA event in Florida that the US must remain the undisputed leader in superintelligence. He added that the US is about a year ahead of China and must win. Trump also warned that sometimes superintelligence is too smart and it might be necessary to reduce its level.

The Hengaw Human Rights Organization reported that five citizens arrested during the nationwide protests of Dey 1404 were sentenced to a total of 25 years of imprisonment by the First Branch of the Revolutionary Court of Semnan. Each of these individuals was sentenced to five years of imprisonment on charges of "acting against national security." These five have been held in Semnan Central Prison since their arrest and have been deprived of leave and legal facilities.

Donald Trump said that a small air defense system in Qeshm was destroyed within about 15 minutes. Two missiles hit Qeshm Island early Saturday. Trump added that they are engaging with Iran and have made progress, and he does not consider the situation a war.

NBC News reported, citing American officials, that some of Donald Trump's advisors have told him that the window for resuming large-scale military operations in Iran is closing. These officials added that Trump's advisors have urged him to act before the new Congress convenes in January 2027, and that resuming large-scale military operations in Iran requires Trump to make his decision within the next few weeks.

The Wall Street Journal reported increased pressure from Trump's advisors to influence his decisions; the disagreements are over continuing diplomacy, resuming military operations, and intensifying economic pressure against Iran.

Fouad Pashaei, Secretary-General of the Iranian Constitutional Party, said the gathering of Iranians in Frankfurt will be held tomorrow despite threats and efforts to cancel Prince Reza Pahlavi's speech. After widespread protests by Iranians against the German police's actions to cancel the event, the police agreed to secure the gathering with increased security measures and higher costs. Pashaei also considered the continuation of protests by Iranians abroad for over ten months as a serious and ongoing sign of opposition to the Islamic Republic.

A group of independent UN experts, including Mai Sato, the Special Rapporteur on human rights in Iran, condemned the increase in personal attacks and threats against the organization's reporters and emphasized that intimidation will not silence them. These experts expressed concern about the rise in insults and threats from some governments and other actors in a statement released on Friday, 15 Aban in Geneva, but did not name any specific country. They called for support from UN officials and cooperation from governments with the reporters.

Farzin Nadimi said the US warning message to the Iranian people does not necessarily mean an imminent military attack, but it can be a warning to the Islamic Republic about the seriousness of a possible military action. He added that the deployment of IRGC and Basij military bases in residential areas limits US operations and may slow down the operation speed. Nadimi said the US aims with these warnings to reduce civilian casualties and prevent the Islamic Republic from using people as human shields.

Donald Trump appointed Stephen Miller, one of his closest advisers and the architect of strict immigration policies, as White House Chief of Staff three days after the Republicans' defeat in the midterm elections.

Omid Memarian, a political analyst, said that the $20 million reward set by the US State Department for information about the Islamic Republic's nuclear program could lead to increased security tensions, more arrests, and security confrontations with citizens in Iran.

Arash Razi, a member of the Central Council of the Constitutional Party of Iran, considered the awarding of the Friedrich Naumann Foundation prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi as a sign of strengthening the European political circles' view of his role in Iran's political future and leadership during the transitional period.
Esteghlal Tehran will face Esteghlal Khuzestan in the twelfth week of the Premier League on Saturday afternoon in Ahvaz. The Tehran team must win this match to stay in the championship race.

Georges-Louis Bouchez, leader of the Reformist Movement in Belgium, called Prince Reza Pahlavi the most important figure opposing the Islamic Republic and considered supporting him natural for supporters of freedom and democracy. He emphasized that the choice of Iran's future political system is solely up to the Iranian people.

Ali Akbar Jangjoo, deputy of the Medical Center for Hajj and Pilgrimage of the Red Crescent Society, said about 48% of pilgrims for Hajj 1406 suffer from one disease and 21% suffer from two diseases simultaneously. He added that about 75% of pilgrims are overweight and emphasized that increased self-care by pilgrims can reduce travel problems. Jangjoo also warned about Saudi Arabia's strictness regarding narcotic drugs, stating that if such drugs are found with a pilgrim, they could be detained for 10 to 15 days.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson for the IRGC, said that the IRGC Aerospace Force will unveil surprises that will astonish the whole world if a third wave of conflict begins. He added that if enemies create threats anywhere, they will be confronted with asymmetric operations. He also emphasized that they will never allow the enemy to stop missile production and upgrades.

An interview with Ali Osat Hashemi, former governor of Sistan and Baluchestan, discusses the challenges of kolbari and fuel carrying in Iran's border areas and the impact of the Border Trade Regulation Law on the security and economic status of border residents. The interview examines the balance between border security and the rights and livelihoods of border residents. It also discusses the role of the government and parliament in defining the authority of military and law enforcement forces and accountability in border incidents.

Parvin Delshad, a member of the Iran Novin Party, in an interview with Iran International, referred to the gathering of Iranians in Brisbane, Australia, in support of the Iranian National Revolution and said that using the freedoms available in their countries of residence to raise the voice of the Iranian people is very important. She recalled the killing of thousands of Iranians in the suppression by the Islamic Republic and emphasized the necessity of the continued presence and protest of Iranians abroad in support of freedom and democracy in Iran.
Sepahan football team defeated Malavan 4-0 in the twelfth week of the Premier League. With this victory, Sepahan reached 18 goals in the last 6 games.

Hossein Alizadeh, an international affairs analyst, said the attacks on targets in Qeshm Island can be assessed within the framework of limited and controlled clashes, and currently there is no will to expand the conflict among Iran, the US, and Israel.

Rouhollah Rahimpour, journalist and political analyst, said that achieving a comprehensive and lasting agreement between Tehran and Washington is very unlikely in the short and even medium term. He emphasized that the efforts of Qatari mediators, at best, could lead to a limited and phased agreement.

A group of Iranians residing in Adelaide, Australia, held a gathering to express their solidarity and support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation in Frankfurt on Saturday.

Abbas Golrou, a member of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, said that Americans want to take everything and give nothing, and continuing negotiations has no benefit. He added that as long as the Americans do not adhere to the Islamic Republic's conditions, no other political process will be pursued. Golrou also said there is a confrontation with the Americans in the Strait of Hormuz, but the diplomatic path is not closed.

Iranians residing in Brisbane, Australia, on Saturday, 16 Aban, hold a march and gathering to support the Iranian national revolution and commemorate the eternal figures of the path to freedom. This gathering coincides with the awarding of the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Prize to the Iranian people. Organizers stated that the purpose of this march is to support the efforts of the Iranian people to end the Islamic Republic and achieve freedom and democracy.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson for the IRGC, said all material and immaterial assets of hostile countries, even outside their geographical borders, are accessible to the Islamic Republic. He added that missile range is constantly being upgraded with no halt. Regarding a possible review of the nuclear doctrine, he said if the regime decides to move in that direction, necessary preparations will be made.

A group of Iranians residing in Malmö, Sweden, sang the anthem "Ey Iran" while traveling to Frankfurt. Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation on behalf of the Iranian people in Frankfurt, Germany, on Saturday.

Ghasem Ravanbakhsh, representative of Qom in the parliament, said that Iran has targeted regional bases of various countries in this war. He added that if European countries like Britain ally with the US, Iran can target even their bases by increasing missile range. Ravanbakhsh also said that with a range of 4000 kilometers, Britain can be targeted without any reservations.

Israel's Channel 12 reported that Benjamin Netanyahu and the head of Mossad intended to carry out an operation against the Islamic Republic before the Israeli elections; the plan faced opposition from security officials and was eventually disclosed to the United States.

A number of Iranians from Hamburg, Germany, traveled to Frankfurt on Saturday, 16 Aban, to support Prince Reza Pahlavi's presence. Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation in Frankfurt on the same day.

Mohammad Panjali, former captain of Persepolis, said at Hamid Alidousti's memorial ceremony that now is not the time to ask questions about football because people are struggling for daily bread. He added that today's footballers have become a nuisance instead of role models, and the stadium is empty for Persepolis games.

Kamran Ghazanfari, Tehran representative in parliament, said the US will be forced to leave the region permanently. He added that we are engaged in a civilizational war and the US mistakenly thought it could end the Islamic Republic in a few days. Ghazanfari also said that by Mojtaba Khamenei's order, the Strait of Hormuz is firmly held and enemies are not allowed to pass.
The Judiciary Media Center reported the execution of Mohammad Aref Shahbakhsh, a security prisoner. He was sentenced to death for rebellion and waging war through armed action in Khash County.

Videos received by Iran International show that a group of students from Gorgan University of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources, in protest against poor food quality and lack of officials' attention to this issue, placed food trays on the ground.

Thousands of Iranians from various parts of Europe gathered in Frankfurt, Germany, on Saturday, 16 Aban, to express their support for the Iranian national revolution and commemorate the immortal figures of the path to freedom. This gathering coincided with the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony for the Iranian people. Prince Reza Pahlavi will receive this award on behalf of the Iranian people.

Ahmad Samadi, a reporter for Iran International, reports from St. Paul's Church in Frankfurt, the venue for the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony given to Prince Reza Pahlavi on behalf of the Iranian people. Bijan Jirsarai, head of the Foreign Policy Committee of the Free Democratic Party of Germany, explains to Ahmad Samadi about this award and the ceremony awarding it to Prince Reza Pahlavi on behalf of the Iranian people.

Five business units including cafes, restaurants, and garden restaurants in Robat Karim county were sealed for reasons including what was described as "non-compliance with religious and legal regulations."

A video shows that Mohammad Sajjad Shahdoust, a singer, on 16 Aban before going to the public and revolutionary prosecutor's office to serve his prison sentence, asked people to be his voice. According to some of his fans, he was arrested during the Dey protests while trying to help an injured person and was released until the sentence was announced. His prison sentence began on Saturday.

A large number of Iranians living in Europe gathered near St. Paul's Church in Frankfurt, Germany. Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation in this city on Saturday, representing the people of Iran.

Sirus Mirzaei, a doctor and human rights activist, spoke with Ahmad Samadi about the importance of awarding a human rights prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi and mentioned that the large public presence at this gathering could be a key day for the convergence of political groups and acceptance of Prince Reza Pahlavi's leadership in the struggle for Iran's freedom.

The Guardian reported that the broad victory of Democrats in the US midterm elections may put the financial relations of Gianni Infantino, FIFA president, with Donald Trump under Congress scrutiny. Jimmy Raskin, a Democratic representative, had previously called for an investigation into corruption allegations and FIFA's financial ties with Trump's associates. Raskin, if he leads the House Judiciary Committee, may demand documents and summon FIFA representatives and institutions related to the Kushner family for investigation.

Narges Eskandari-Gronberg said in an interview with Ahmad Samadi that she calls on all parties to stand with the people of Iran and not forget that the people of Iran need their voices to be heard and the support of the international community.

Heavy rainfall in Tehran caused increased water flow and roaring rivers in the Darband and Air Force areas. Published images show the intensity of the water flow in these areas. At the same time, a red-level warning has been issued for Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari, northern Khuzestan, southern Lorestan and Kurdistan, and northern half of Tehran.

A video shows the moment Prince Reza Pahlavi and his wife Yasmin Pahlavi entering the church where the Freedom Award ceremony is held in Frankfurt, Germany. Prince Reza Pahlavi is scheduled to receive the 2026 Freedom Award from the Friedrich Naumann Foundation on Saturday, 16 Aban, representing the people of Iran.

Heavy rain in Ilam caused widespread flooding of streets and flash floods in some parts of the city. Images show some roads and vehicles submerged, disrupting citizens' traffic. The Ilam governor's office announced that due to the heavy rain, activities of kindergartens, preschool centers, and elementary schools in the province will be held remotely on the afternoon shift of Saturday, 16 Aban [Gregorian: 2026-11-07].

According to a video received by Iran International, on Saturday, 16 Aban and simultaneously with the awarding of the Freedom Prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi in Frankfurt, a group of Iranians in Bordeaux, France, displayed placards about the suppression of protests in Iran.

Thousands of Iranians from various parts of Europe gathered today, Saturday, 16 Aban, in Frankfurt, Germany, simultaneously with the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony to the Iranian nation. Ali Hasanpour, a reporter for Iran International, spoke with several participants on the sidelines of this gathering. The participants expressed their solidarity and support for the people of Iran in these conversations.
The United States, Armenia, and Azerbaijan announced in a joint statement the start of technical negotiations for the implementation of the Zangazur transit route, known as the "Trump Route."

Mohammad Javad Akbarin said that a gathering of a group of supporters of the Islamic Republic against military commanders and political officials took place while the government is trying to present a unified image of its supporters. He considered these gatherings as a sign of internal disputes within the government over negotiation, continuation of the war, and accusations of betrayal against the commanders.

Marie-Agnes Strack-Zimmermann, Chair of the European Parliament's Security and Defense Committee, said at the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony to Prince Reza Pahlavi that the IRGC should be listed as a terrorist organization. She added that the survival of the Islamic Republic depends on creating fear inside Iran and that the German government should provide more support for the Iranian people's struggle for freedom.

Videos published on social media show that on 16 Aban in Tehran, a group of Saipa voucher holders protested the delay in vehicle delivery and registration. They said some have not received their cars for more than a year, while Saipa has done pre-sales for the next year and is holding buyers' money.

Hossein Darabi, a detainee related to the protests of Dey 1404, was sentenced to 25 years in prison by Branch 28 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. The sentence was issued on charges of "cooperation with hostile states." Darabi received the sentence on Tuesday, 12 Aban, in Greater Tehran Prison.

Bijan Jirsarai, foreign policy spokesperson of the Free Democratic Party of Germany, at the Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony to Prince Reza Pahlavi on behalf of the Iranian people, said the Iranian people have been fighting for freedom for decades and deserve this award. He added that the Iranian people fight for freedom worldwide and governments that kill their own people should not benefit from Europe's appeasement policy.

Today, a number of contract urban service workers of Ilam Municipality held a protest in front of the Ilam Governorate building. The protesting workers stated job status conversion among their demands.
This morning, a woman was killed by her husband in the Afsariyeh neighborhood of Tehran. The accused man then attempted self-harm and was transferred to the hospital.
Videos received by Iran International show Iranians at a gathering in Frankfurt, held simultaneously with the awarding of the Freedom Prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi, shouting "Long live the Shah."

Prince Reza Pahlavi said at the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony that despite pressures, the people of Iran are rebuilding their strength and finding new ways to continue their struggle. He added that the people of Iran have not allowed the resistance and memory of their victims to be erased.

Mahmoud Nabavian, a member of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, called for a review of the composition of the negotiation team with the United States. He asked Mohsen Rezaei on the social network X to reconsider the members of the negotiation team in the current sensitive conditions. Nabavian referred to the failed experiences of negotiations with the US and said that former members are also present in the ongoing negotiations.

Iraj Mesdaghi, a political analyst, said the focus of the struggle is the freedom of Iran and opposition to the Islamic Republic, not divisions among Iranians. He added that Prince Reza Pahlavi considers himself the trustee of an award that is to be given to the brave people of Iran and has extended a hand of friendship to all Iranians, both supporters and critics.

Vahid Sarlak, an athlete, after the 2026 Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Award ceremony, considered the main message of the event to be unity among the people of Iran. He said the award was given to the people of Iran and the youth who are fighting for freedom. Sarlak added that the final decision-maker about Iran's fate is the people of Iran, not Berlin, Washington, or any other capital.

Amir Shahidi-Nejad, father of Mehrshad Shahidi-Nejad, was sentenced to two years and six months suspended imprisonment and a fine instead of two years and six months of actual imprisonment. Mehrshad Shahidi-Nejad was killed during the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests in 1401. Amir Shahidi-Nejad had previously criticized the judicial process.

Reports have emerged about explosions in Isfahan that were later announced as "controlled explosions of unexploded ammunition in the south and north of Isfahan." These explosions were heard at various times on the morning of Saturday, 16 Aban [2026-11-07], causing shaking of windows and the ground. Additionally, sounds of explosions were reported in Shiraz, which had been announced beforehand.

Contrary to Iran's international commitments under the Convention on the Rights of the Child and obligations regarding the non-use of children in military affairs, 37 female high school students from Buin Miandasht county were sent to operational areas in the south of the country as part of the so-called "Rahian-e Noor" tours. Also, a Rahian-e Noor camp official in Golestan province announced that 1,000 male students and 1,000 female students from the counties of Maraveh Tappeh, Gomishan, Bandar-e Gaz, and Aq Qala will be sent to operational areas.

In Frankfurt, a wall has been erected in memory of Iran's martyrs, especially the victims of the bloody suppression on the 18th and 19th of Dey. Sosha Makani told Iran International that Iranians had a large presence at this gathering and emphasized that wherever Prince Reza Pahlavi is, they are also present. He added that they are striving for the victory of the final battle and the freedom of Iran so that the blood of the martyrs is not in vain.
A video received by Iran International shows a gathering of Iranians in Frankfurt after the Freedom Award was given to Prince Reza Pahlavi.

Hossein Mohseni, spokesperson for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, announced on Saturday, 16 Aban, in a press conference that the range limitations of Iran's missiles have been lifted. He warned that if a new round of conflicts with the US and Israel begins, the IRGC Aerospace Force will deploy weapons and capabilities that will surprise the world. Mohseni added that these capabilities must be demonstrated in practice and mere slogans are not enough.
The head of the judiciary in Bam county reported the execution of a prisoner previously sentenced to death for the murder of his wife.

A video sent by a viewer to Iran International shows that on Saturday, simultaneously with the awarding of the Friedrich Naumann Foundation Freedom Prize in Germany, a memorial wall was erected for the martyrs of the Iranian National Revolution.

Borzo Arjmand said in an interview with Iran International that all Iranians abroad try to be the voice of the Iranian people and inform governments about events in Iran. He stated that 99% of artists inside Iran oppose the Islamic Republic and added that they shout abroad instead of the artists inside and will succeed.
According to videos received by Iran International, Iranians participating in the Frankfurt gathering, which took place after awarding a prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi, shouted "Long live the Shah."

The Iraqi Foreign Minister said on Saturday, 16 Aban, that the current situation indicates the possibility of a renewed war in the region, and the US has officially asked Baghdad to close all its border crossings with Iran except for two. He said Baghdad has informed Tehran that it accepts friendship and alliance with Iran but does not accept the Islamic Republic's interference in Iraq's internal affairs. He also announced ongoing negotiations with the Najba Movement and Kata'ib Hezbollah regarding weapons and said Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq and Kata'ib Sayyid al-Shuhada have agreed to control their weapons.

Ali Zaghi and Ilya Akbari, two detainees from the January 1404 protests, were sentenced to death by the Mashhad Revolutionary Court. They were tried in a joint case called 'Shandiz' along with four others. The charges include waging war through participation in destruction of public property and setting fire to religious centers.

Masoumeh Taherkhani, an economic analyst, said that the transfer of sanctions from Asia to Canada shows that the US aims to limit the financial routes of the Islamic Republic worldwide. She added that cryptocurrency networks and transfers of Tether and Bitcoin are also traceable, and these measures increase the cost and difficulty for the Islamic Republic to circumvent sanctions.

Ali Zaghi and Ilya Akbari, two detainees of the Iranian National Revolution in Dey 1404, were sentenced to death in the case known as "Shandiz." According to Harana, the charges against these six prisoners include "waging war through participation in the destruction of public property and burning religious centers" and "assembly and collusion against national security." The death sentences of Mehdi Zarif and Hossein Rasouli-Nasab have been confirmed, while the sentences of Ali Zaghi, Ilya Akbari, Matin Shabani, and Hassan Golshan-Nejad are at the preliminary stage.

Esteghlal football team was held to a 2-2 draw against Esteghlal Khuzestan in Ahvaz in the 12th week of the Premier League. Saleh Hardani scored in minutes 65 and 90+12 for Esteghlal, while Seyed Mehdi Mousavi in minute 88 and Aref Rostami in minute 90+5 scored for Esteghlal Khuzestan.
